newsitem.title: USA: Unifi says 1.8 mln shrs tendered in auction.
newsitem.headline: Unifi says 1.8 mln shrs tendered in auction.

text.p: Unifi Inc said on Tuesday that 1.76 million shares were tendered and not withdrawn it its recent "Dutch Auction" tender offer which expired on December 13.

Unifi said it purchased all tendered shares at $31 per share. The repurchased shares represented about 2.7 percent of the Unifi's outstanding stock immediately prior to the offer, it said. After purchasing the shares, Unifi has about 62.8 million shares of common stock outstanding.
Unifi announced the tender offer on October 30, 1996 saying it planned to purchase up to 6 million shares at a range of $28 to $31 per share.
